text:
Liz: quick heads-up — ran the nightly link-scan and Lighthouse flagged ~20 404s under /runtime/packaging (mostly shortlinks and a couple old diagram hosts). pinging @John and @Maya for owner triage. can someone take a quick sweep? here's the report: https://lighthouse/reports/6821

John: I can take the packaging overview and quickstart pages. ETA EOD today. which files are highest priority?

Liz: top hits: runtime/packaging/quickstart.md, runtime/packaging/faq.md, and runtime/packaging/images/diagram-v1.png

Maya: I can pick up the faq and images. if these are straightforward host swaps, this sed does the trick locally:
```
sed -i 's|http://oldcdn.example.com/|https://assets.redwood.com/|g' runtime/packaging/*.md
```
I'll open a PR once I confirm previews.

Sam: quick reminder — if you replace shortlinks, update the redirects table at `docs/redirects.csv` and add an entry to the CHANGELOG so enterprise customers see the change.

Maya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4721 — small host swap + replace for a couple stale anchors. preview looks ok but tagging for review. @Liz can you sanity-check staging preview when you have a sec?

Liz: looked quickly, :thumbsup: images and links resolve in preview. one tiny nit — code block in quickstart lost a trailing newline after the curl snippet, I'll add that comment in the PR.

deploy-bot: snapshot created for branch maya/packaging-link-fix (preview: https://preview.redwood.com/sha/abc123)

John: after Maya's PR merges I'll re-run the scan for any lingering 404s. might need support to rehost two diagrams that are 403 on the old host.

Maya: thanks — @support can you rehost runtime/packaging/images/diagram-v1.png and diagram-v2.svg if we need it?

support: noted, created ticket #1382 in the rehost queue and added the two assets. ETA 2 business days.

Liz: great — once PR merges and support confirms assets, marking this sweep done. assigning runbook owner to John for follow-ups on packaging docs. thanks all :pray:
